newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rexel buys US , Portuguese, Italian firms.
newsitem.headline: Rexel buys US , Portuguese, Italian firms.

text.p: Rexel, a unit of retailer Pinault-Printemps-Redoute, said on Thursday it has finalised the acquisition of the holding company of Elfin of Italy, bought U.S. Chemco Electric Supply, and acquired Tecnitel of Portugal.

Elfin, based in northern Italy, has annual turnover of around 210 million francs and employs 105 people. The acquisition brings Rexel's sales in Italy to 700 million francs and four percent of the national market.
Rexel bought on May 1 Tampa, Florida-based Chemco, which had 1996 sales of 130 million francs and employs 60. Lisbon-based Tecnitel has sales of 70 million francs and 30 staff.
Rexel, an electrical equipment retailer, gave no details of the acquisition terms.
